mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is today's balanced dish. Expect clear skies today with a high of 84 degrees that feels more like 87 down at Verona Community Park. Under tonight's waxing crescent moon, keep your eyes on the skies at 9:30 PM for a five-minute view of the International Space Station passing from the northwest to the northeast.

In city news, Verona is continuing its push for green living. Apartment dwellers looking to compost can drop food waste off at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city is promoting a Solar Group Buy program through Dane County, making solar panel installation easier and cheaper for local homeowners.

There is plenty happening around town, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Louie on Friday, July 17th. On Saturday, July 18th, you can check out the Dane County Farmers' Market on the Capitol square or head to the Mount Horeb Art Fair. Mark your calendars for next week too, with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Louie, and the Verona Downtown Farmers' Market at Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday.

In the weekly police report, on Friday, July 10th, at 7:26 AM, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash at Old PB and Whalen Road. A 24-year-old cyclist from Oshkosh sustained minor injuries, and a 49-year-old Verona man was cited for failing to yield the right of way.
Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10:00 AM today. Today's delicious Flavor of the Day is Snickers Swirl, and if you are planning ahead, tomorrow's flavor will be Mint Cookie.
